supplementary_explanations.explanation: The shipped checker requires the exact substring 'DIVERGING = ['. Actual source uses 'DIVERGING   = ['. AST parsing verifies the complete named palette with the exact expected values; no source or raw finding was changed.

The shipped regular expressions do not evaluate figsize=(183/25.4,...). Safe AST arithmetic gives 183 mm for both source declarations. Exported PDF/PNG widths are separately measured; the new script exports the fixed canvas boundary.

pdfplumber char['size'] is a vertical bounding-box measure: for a 90-degree label it can equal the glyph advance width (e.g. the 7pt letter i is reported as 1.554). Font-size compliance uses actual PDF Tf values from pypdf visitor_text, multiplied by the text and graphics matrix scale. Raw pdfplumber minima remain recorded for transparency.
Any lexical warning is caused by words such as 'bars' in prose. AST contains no bar/barh/boxplot call; the figures use points/intervals and empirical CDFs.

The shipped legend detector only searches 30 characters after .legend(. Both calls use bbox_to_anchor later in their arguments. The hash-bound current PNG review confirms external bottom legends; future renders need a new visual review.

observations: Viewed the actual 2161 x 1665 PNG at original resolution after the final render. Two biological rows are Proteins (2203 records, 1500 families) and Protein complexes (860 records, 261 families), with panels a-f and 14 fixed method/configuration rows in each group.
Blue, ochre and teal are visibly retained. The plot is not rendered in grayscale; direct labels, circle/diamond/triangle/square markers and fixed row positions supplement color.

The final MAE axes show 0.0, 0.5 and 1.0 ticks. The previous awkward endpoint label is removed. No clipped labels or overlap among method names, axis text, group headings or the footer/legend was observed.

Points and family-cluster intervals fit within each axis. Protein-group intervals are often smaller than their markers; this is not a claim that intervals are absent. Larger complex-group intervals remain visible.
All six nonphysical-MAE cells for FastProtFlex, ANM and GNM visibly say relative score. No physical error values were fabricated for them.

The footer visibly states 14 completed entries, same 3063 records and mixed training exposure. It is on separate lines above the bottom color legend. This does not claim equal training or completion of deferred heavy models.
Viewed the actual 2161 x 921 PNG at original resolution after the final render. Two panels use the same two biological labels and n=2203/860.
The six displayed configurations are FlexPPI, BackFlip-2.1 assembly, BackFlip-2.1 chains, DynaProt-M, FastProtFlex and ANM. All six names fit in the external two-row legend.

Blue and teal curves and four ochre curves retain named solid/dashed/dotted/dash-dot patterns. ANM has its separate dash-dot-dot pattern; this supplements color even where some protein-group curves overlap.

Titles, axis labels, tick labels, legend and training-exposure footer are visible without observed clipping or overlap. Negative-rank observations remain within the data-driven full x range; no local zoom or nonlinear axis is used.
The distribution shape is descriptive across all records; the visual does not imply that the 244 related TCR-pMHC records are independent sequence families.

limitations: No future image is considered visually reviewed merely because this script runs successfully.
No color-vision simulation or printed-page inspection was performed.
ECDF all-observation inclusion was inspected in source code/audit assertions; this memory-light QA does not reload the large per-record or residue-level scoring files.
PNG is a 300 dpi preview; PDF/SVG are vector masters for line art. Canvas-bound exports preserve the 183 mm physical width; actual PDF and PNG dimensions are measured.
